title: Paperclip and the Gehlen network as a homecoming; Nazi Germany as a field laboratory

tellings.quote: that in a lot of ways both paperclip and the absorption of the Galen network were a homecoming. It's almost as if Nazi Germany was set up as a field laboratory to do some highly unethical things.

plain: Operation Paperclip, the postwar US program that brought German scientists to America, and the absorption of the spy network of the German general Reinhard Gehlen into US intelligence were really a "homecoming", as if Nazi Germany had been set up as a field laboratory for highly unethical work. A philosopher and researcher named Jason Jorjani puts this forward as his own reading, naming no source, in a conversation about what he calls Hitler's secret UFO program.
